target: any designated main-structure component reaches its specified ignition condition by horizon
scope: conditional vulnerability given an exposure scenario; not annual risk

wind.direction: meteorological direction FROM, degrees clockwise from north

moisture.unit: kg water per kg dry fuel

material_assignment.note: Clay tile and stucco surfaces must not automatically inherit wood combustion. Model combustible substrates where relevant.

exposure.external_ember_exposure: explicitly included or excluded; absence is not a zero-risk observation

label.positive: successful run and valid main-structure ignition event
label.negative: successful full-horizon run and no main-structure ignition event

risk_aggregation.nonuniform_training_sampling: record inclusion probabilities or sampling policy; do not interpret sample frequency as physical probability

evaluation.acceptance_tolerance: not yet finalized; 5 percentage points discussed provisionally, not demonstrated
